value: Edit directly in your browser, no local files needed; supports litematic/schem with comprehensive house categories.
Generate builds from a text or image description, then fine-tune on the page before exporting.
Veteran online editor with controls close to in-game; format support is slightly weaker.
Web version of Survivalcraft. Includes origami-style animals and explosion splashes by default; supports plugins, circuits, and Linux.
Survivalcraft Workshop beginner guide with code-level details on mechanics and data. For more, visit scnet.top.
Heads-up: this is actually the Minecraft (Java) ecosystem — mod and modpack discovery, nothing to do with Survivalcraft. Filter by version, loader and category; e.g. Create, Farmer's Delight, Sodium.
1:1 open-source replica of v1.4.5.8. Import original saves, supports original mods and textures.
Terraria map downloads as a supplement to the Steam Workshop.
Pixel editing for Terraria .wld map files.
Largest MC map site. Adventure, parkour, survival and more.
Full resource pack editor: edit vanilla textures directly, animations, models and sounds.
Share .vox files with categorized props and vegetation; live preview included.
Rust-built open-world ARPG with dungeons, loot, gliding, multiplayer and cave exploration. Great for players who want more combat and complex controls.
The closest MC experience on the Luanti engine. Survival, building, redstone, nether and more, highly customizable.
Industrial simulation + tower defense. Mining, conveyors, production lines, turrets. A must-play for redstone and RTS fans.
Feed in a seed and version to see every slime chunk. Slimes only spawn below Y=40 inside those chunks — mark them here first, then carve the farm (layered platforms) for slimeballs and slime blocks.
Renders a server world into a web 3D map; the official demo opens a 31 GB save. Double-click anywhere to jump there, hit the 4th button at the top right to fly around, the 1st to toggle lighting.

Official 3D map of the Wynncraft MMO: per-dimension layers (Wynn, Gavel, Corkus, sky islands…), quest markers, waypoints, trade-market prices and live player dots; links share exact coordinates. Connect at play.wynncraft.com straight from a vanilla client.
Browser voxel editor for the .vox ecosystem. Large canvas, AI generation and export.
Web version of the professional MC model editor. Full bone and animation tools.
Open a Java world in the browser, fly through it, export .schem/.glb/.stl, and drop 3D models onto the terrain to test them.
Seed map showing villages, strongholds, biomes and slime chunks at a glance. Java and Bedrock supported.
MC ecosystem terrain generator and editor app as a web version.
Convert images pixel-by-pixel into map art. Floor or board, export as schematic or map.dat.
Offline world renderer with cinematic lighting and depth of field; the gallery is MC shot like a film.
JavaScript pack scripting with 5 API groups — registry, events, recipes, tags, client — no Java required.
Simulates redstone behavior directly; interactions match the game.
2D circuit wiring view, easy creation and single-step debugging.
PackCrafter is the fuller resource-pack editor: pixels, animations, sounds and 3D preview.
Bloxelizer leans toward viewing and conversion: step-by-step build video, layer slicing, bill of materials, model-to-blocks.

More than recipes: 20+ recipe types plus loot tables, advancements, predicates, item modifiers, damage types, enchantments, trim patterns, banner patterns, jukebox songs and worldgen schemas like dimensions. Fill the form, get JSON, switch schemas 26.2–26.4.
86 Java commands with version-aware syntax for 1.17–26.3; the same site ships a full skin editor.
Assemble mob equipment, attributes and variants, preview in 3D, export a /summon command.
Linux server, self-hosted game panel with Docker isolation.
Veteran MC source-level creation IDE. Supports data packs, structures, and visual programming for mob AI. Linux and Raspberry Pi supported.
Open-source launcher and modpack manager: one-click mod installs and updates, instance import, built-in skin switcher.

The Bedrock-edition powerhouse: an IDE for Minecraft Add-Ons with an extensible compiler, rich autocompletion and live previews, auto-syncing behavior/resource/skin packs and worlds into the com.mojang folder. GPL-3.0.
